name: Fox News
description: Follow Fox News, a tracked company, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: More Gen Z college freshmen are quitting school early and moving back home with mom and dad
changes.summary: Some Gen Z freshmen have already decided — just weeks into the fall semester — to abandon their college campuses, head back home and take classes online. Others are quitting school entirely very early on. In a recent "Outnumbered" segment , the Fox News co-hosts discussed the trend of young college students bailing out.

changes.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
changes.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.
